dedupe_keys.name: geodes cnes earth observation data portal

description: GEODES is the portal of the French space agency CNES for Earth observation space data for science and innovation. Its dataset pages list products such as InSAR ground deformation products from the FLATSIM processing chain for areas including the Tian Shan, southern Mexico and Mozambique, which give high-precision measurements of surface displacement from systematic InSAR analysis, alongside products of the THEIA data centre such as Sentinel-2 surface reflectance syntheses and the reprocessed Sentinel-2 L2A and L3A archive. The portal also publishes an operations log and news on French Earth observation use, and on 25 September 2026 it announced a user survey ahead of a new version of the portal. Access is free for the datasets listed; licences are given per dataset and no single licence is stated on the pages read. Caveats: the portal is in French, and a new version is being prepared, so page addresses may change. Coverage is worldwide, depending on the dataset. It supports hazard exposure analysis such as ground deformation near infrastructure from InSAR, and land and vegetation monitoring; related records are ESA Earth Online and the DLR EOC Geoservice.
